title: Replacement History and Delivery Room for a New Pet's Tailwise Autoship
content:
Replacement shipments widen the delivery room taken away in the days between shipments of a second pet's own Autoship Everyday subscription under Tailwise Autoship (opened for an item the household already receives on another pet's Autoship). The count is of free replacement shipments released on the existing Autoship of the item.

| Replacement shipments released on the existing Autoship in the last twelve months | Days taken away as delivery room |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 9, in place of the program's promised carrier transit days |
| exactly 1 | 5, in place of the program's promised carrier transit days |
| none | not widened |

A record counts as dated in the last N months when its date is later than the same calendar day N months before the day the value is worked out, so a record dated exactly N months earlier does not count; a record dated between six and twelve months ago is one dated in the last twelve months but not in the last six months.

**Hypothetical record.** One replacement released eleven months ago: 5 days. Two, released three and seven months ago: 9 days.
